diagnostic: R13 existing geometric bend / rigid hardware and normal transport
method: Build each default rest model once. Clone only selected real BufferGeometries and call the exact existing bendGeometry(clone,last,30). All other parameters remain at default. No renderer or physical solver is involved.
limits: Only default shoe parameters and bend 0 / 30 degrees are measured.
Rigid metal treatment is a design constraint; no real material strength or wearer-fit claims.
Normal comparison is exact smooth deformation differential versus stored normal; not rendered pixels or triangle-normal fitting.
Antipodal chord samples identify geometric distortion; they do not certify a manufactured hole size.
